scope: Read-only primary paper, author project, official data cards, pinned repository trees/README and four small config/task/metric files. No environment installation, model/policy training, simulator execution, paid calls or project edits.
task: Observed empty shell + exact furniture text inventory with unknown sizes -> FastFill layout/size -> RoomGenBench assets/assembly -> navigation AND manipulation validation.

entries.name: HSSD-200 / HSSD-Habitat
entries.paper_title: Habitat Synthetic Scenes Dataset (HSSD-200): An Analysis of 3D Scene Scale and Realism Tradeoffs for ObjectGoal Navigation
entries.venue: CVPR 2024; 2023 initial preprint (not first introduced in2024)
entries.official_proof: Author project Code link explicitly resolves to 3dlg-hcvc/hssd; dataset linked from project and Habitat documentation.
entries.type: Human-authored synthetic scene/asset dataset with actual navigation experiments, not a text-to-layout generator.
entries.data_scope: 211 scenes;18,656 original object models. Current HSSD-Hab data additionally contains collision meshes/receptacles, uncluttered scenes and articulated v0.3.0 variants.

navigation_evidence.reported_protocol: DDPPO/VER pixels-to-actions ObjectNav agents; train/val/test scene split60/20/20;1K train episodes/scene for HSSD;30val episodes/scene. Three independent training runs; best-val-SPL checkpoints. Cross-domain zero-shot HM3DSem/MP3D and fine-tuning comparisons.
navigation_evidence.result_example: HSSD-122 pretraining -> HM3DSem19.15%Success/7.71SPL, vs ProcTHOR10K12.53%/5.26 (paper Table5).
navigation_evidence.scope_limit: Result is policy generalization under that simulator/agent/training protocol; not an automatic score for every new generated layout.

manipulation_evidence.original_paper_status: No manipulation-task success benchmark established by original HSSD paper in this check; original paper is ObjectNav.
manipulation_evidence.current_data_status: Official HSSD-Hab dataset card v0.3.0 reports202fully articulated scenes,161public; remaining scenes/assets internal test. Includes receptacles, URDF/articulated configs and accessibility filters, plus uncluttered scenes for rearrangement episode generation.
manipulation_evidence.boundary: Manipulation-ready data/episode-generation support is stronger than a staticGLB, but not evidence the original paper ran manipulation success evaluation or that FastFill outputs are manipulation-ready.

code_evidence.observed: Paper results use habitat-sim/lab v0.2.5; current compatibility is not exact paper protocol.
Zero-shot evaluation configuration and checkpoint link.
500step horizon,RGB-D256x256,79degHFOV,0.88m camera/agent height,0.18m radius,sliding disabled; selectedconfig read.

dependencies: Habitat simulator/lab and appropriate pinned version, assets, semantics, navmesh, taskepisodes, pretrainedpolicy.
CC-BY-NC4.0 gated data access; no data downloaded.

fastfill_relation.role: Asset/catalog and observed-shell/task-source provider plus ObjectNav evaluation reference. It is not a competing fixed-inventory unknown-size layout generator.
required_adapter: Extract shell and required inventory without leaking GT sizes/poses/support; keep dataset split and canonical instance IDs.
Convert assembled meshes/transforms to Habitat configs with collision and semantic goal metadata; rebuild agent-specific navmesh.
Existing episodes refer to native object locations and cannot be reused blindly after FastFill rearrangement. Generate matched tasks/seeds/goal categories and report task-generation failures.
Keep real asset size known track separate from unknown-size predicted-layout track.
fastfill_relation.not_proven: No model/runtime run in this audit; no claim FastFill/RoomGenBench is already Habitat compatible or has improved ObjectNav.

entries.name: GRScenes / GRUtopia (current InternUtopia)
entries.paper_title: GRUtopia: Dream General Robots in a City at Scale
entries.venue: 2024 arXiv preprint; no conference venue asserted here.
entries.official_proof: Paper explicitly links OpenRobotLab/GRUtopia; it currently redirects to InternRobotics/InternUtopia. Official HF dataset also redirects OpenRobotLab -> InternRobotics.
entries.type: Scene/robot/NPC simulator platform and GRBench tasks, not fixed-inventory text-to-layout baseline.
entries.data_scope: Paper claims100k scene prototypes across89categories. Current official released GRScenes data card states99environments (69home+30commercial). Do not claim100kpublic downloadable full scenes.

navigation_evidence.embodiment: UnitreeH1 RGB-D humanoid; explicit locomotion/fall-reset control.
navigation_evidence.boundary: Paper locomotion uses explicit fall/reset mechanism; navigation success without reset statistics can hide physical failures.

manipulation_evidence.task: AlienGo mobile base + UnitreeZ1 arm picks handheld object and places in target receptacle satisfying up to2conditions; multiple valid placements allowed.
manipulation_evidence.reported_result: Paper§4.4 reports Loco-Manipulation SR=0 for studied baselines, with collision/locomotion/planning failures; existence of evaluation is not proof reliable manipulation.
manipulation_evidence.extra_control_experiment: PaperTable3 separately compares flat vs furnished environments and reports manipulation controller success drop100%->8%; distinct from end-to-endGRBench0%.
manipulation_evidence.boundary: Do not merge controller and full-task results or call scene loading successful manipulation.

current_code_evidence.observed: Current platform links separate InternNav and InternManip benchmark documentation.
Pinned README requires IsaacSim4.5.0 and NVIDIA runtime.
Actual current distance metric calc implementation.
Current manipulation task delegates episode finish and configured metric calculation; this is not a complete paper SR/SCR evaluator by itself.

entries.code_publication_boundary: Complete current platform tree and selected tiny task/metric files checked. Current README delegates benchmarks to InternNav/InternManip; their complete evaluators and exact correspondence to2024paper runs were not audited. Do not assert full original benchmark reproduction.
entries.scene_format: Separate raw USD, navigation USD and interaction USD plus interactive-object metadata. One USD variant is not automatically interchangeable across tasks.
dependencies: IsaacSim/physics runtime, robot/controllers, task configs, benchmark metadata and semantic goal/condition annotations.
Data usage agreement and CC-BY-NC-SA4.0 scenes; no assets downloaded.

fastfill_relation.role: Existing scene/asset/robot/task source and possible physics evaluation backend after assembly.
required_adapter: Compile RoomGenBench GLB/object instances into relocatable USD with units/up-axis/transforms/materials, convex collision/inertia/mass/friction and contact settings.
Generate interactive-object lists/receptacles and articulated joints where task needs them; mesh shape alone lacks these.
Freeze one robot, gripper/controller, scene version, start/goal/task distribution and horizon for all methods.
Validate raw/nav/interaction conversions separately. Count missing assets, physics-settle failures, invalid episode generation and unreachable goals over original requests.
fastfill_relation.not_proven: No simulator or robot rollout executed; no claim generated rooms already support manipulation.

checks: Native vs fitted extent error and axis transforms
Mesh collision/OOB, verified supports, openings and no-placeholder success
Agent-specific navmesh and door-seeded reachable start/goals
Manipulation receptacles/grasp workspace/arm swept-volume and goal-condition evaluability
All-input failure accounting; no silently dropped task-generation failures
Navigation SR/SPL/path length/collision/fall-reset counts over matched episodes
Manipulation pick/place task SR and per-conditionSCR, collision and stability after release
Fixed policy/robot/controller/horizon to separate scene quality from agent ability
Report oracle geometric/planning solvability separately from perception-policy performance
Train agents under matched scene/episode/training compute and evaluate held-out transfer
Do not infer trainability/generalization from one successful rollout or loadable file

core_conclusion: HSSD offers real ObjectNav experiment/code evidence, while original HSSD manipulation claims should stay at current data-readiness level unless another benchmark is explicitly selected. GRUtopia reports both navigation and manipulation experiments but with weak end-to-end manipulation performance; current public data scale is99 environments and benchmark code has evolved. Neither is a direct same-input layout-generation baseline.
